snippet.title: Age of Empires IV: Yue Fei's Legacy Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Live the legacy of Yue Fei as he leads the Song Dynasty forces in a fight for survival against the ruthless Jin Dynasty invaders. When the north falls and the Song imperial court is captured, Yue Fei and fellow commander Han Shizhong protect an escaping young Song prince from the Jin and rally an impassioned fight for the dynasty’s survival against a seemingly unstoppable enemy. 

In addition to the dramatic 8-mission campaign, Yue Fei’s Legacy introduces the Jin Dynasty as a brand-new playable civilization that excels in cavalry and siege. Boost your military production with unique Grasslands, expedite your economy with Mounted Villagers, and bend neutral settlements to your will. Test your skills against friends or AI opponents as you combine elite Iron Pagoda heavy cavalry, close-range Eruptor hand cannons, and Mounted Grenadiers to crush enemy armies in storms of steel and fire. 

Immerse yourself with Jin-inspired music, Jin-specific masteries that pull you deeper into the era, and four new maps and two striking biomes to explore.

*This expansion is inspired by historical events with artistic liberties for gameplay. 

Audio Description: https://youtu.be/QmQCk2cJjCY
